environment.description: ECS Fargate service behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a basic health check listener and forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group. The PostgreSQL RDS instance (v14.9) is in the same VPC with security group allowing inbound from the ECS service SG. The database user configured in DATABASE_URL has SELECT privileges on the reports table. No additional middleware or proxy between ALB and the application container. Container runs node:18-slim with default configuration.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, no WAF attached
config.db_user_privileges: SELECT on reports, pg_read_all_data role not granted
config.network: Private subnet, NAT gateway for egress
